title: Momentum (parkour)
description: A Minecraft mod that adds fluid parkour and mobility mechanics—sliding, wall-running, dodging, and more—inspired by the movement systems of Apex Legends and Titanfall.
body:
# Momentum

A parkour and mobility mod for Minecraft that adds fluid movement mechanics and acrobatic actions.

## Features

### Core Mechanics

- Reduced air resistance for smoother movement
- Horizontal speed scales with jump boost
- Dynamic water speed based on collision box submersion ratio
- Prone/crawl support
- Auto-slope: descend slopes smoothly without launching off edges (based on vanilla step height)
- Fast ladder climbing/sliding with sprint key
- **Jet Booster** equipment: enhanced base speed, jump height, and strengthened actions
- HUD key prompts for all active abilities
  - `Shift + M` to disable mobility mode (vanilla compatibility with other mods)
  - `Shift + N` to toggle key prompts
  - Visual effects and prompts configurable in client mod settings

### Action System

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Slide** | Triggered when moving fast enough while going prone. Accelerates downhill. |
| **Roll (Ukemi)** | Reduces fall damage when crouching on landing. Well-timed rolls reduce damage further. Transitions into slide if forward speed exceeds fall speed. Greatly reduced fall damage with Jet Booster. |
| **Dodge** | Quick directional dash with i-frames on the ground (4 directions). Usable mid-air with Jet Booster. |
| **Wall Climb** | Climb walls vertically based on jump strength. Minimum upward speed guaranteed with Jet Booster. |
| **Wall Slide** | Slow your descent and reduce fall damage while pressing into a wall. |
| **Wall Hang** | Hang on ledges or grooves. Move left/right while hanging. |
| **Wall Kick** | Jump away from a wall with boosted distance. |
| **Vault** | Jump again while hanging to pull yourself up onto the wall. |
| **Wall Entry** | Enter 1-block-high gaps in prone posture from a ledge or standing position. |
| **Wall Run** | Run along a wall surface when moving fast enough parallel to it. No height loss with Jet Booster. |

### Quality of Life

- Extensive tweaks to friction, drag, and movement across various states — without affecting vanilla gameplay feel
- Nearly all active abilities show contextual key prompts on HUD
- Mobility mode can be fully disabled for vanilla compatibility

## Planned Features

- Double jump
- More equipment / modular gear: Jetpack, Grappling Hook, Phase Shift (TBD)

## Compatibility

- Use `Shift + M` to disable all mobility features if conflicts arise with other mods

## Feedback

Bug reports and suggestions are welcome on GitHub! 

Please include:
- Mod list / environment info
- Description of the issue
- Minecraft version and mod version
